t: Patented, 12mm diameter grooved rods that carry a powerful water-repellent material. Rods are inserted into pre-drilled 12mm holes along the mortar lines of a building. Water-repellent material diffuses into the damp masonry, curing to form a highly effective barrier to damp, resulting in a damp-proof course which stops further rising damp from occurring and helps the wall to dry.
